name: NOXO
description: NOXCAT is a self-custodial Web3 wallet that provides users with access to digital asset management, DeFi tools, and other on-chain services through a unified application. In addition to standard wallet functions such as storing, sending, and receiving digital assets, NOXCAT delivers products including on-chain escrow, collateralized lending, social communication, and other blockchain-based financial tools. The goal is to reduce the complexity of using decentralized applications by bringing commonly used on-chain functions into a more accessible consumer interface. NOXO is the utility and governance token of NOXCAT, enabling holders to participate in governance and selected functions within the platform.
